title: Paid Acquisition Specialist/Paid ADS Strategist (Restricted/Gray Market Categories)
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Rebel X Brands is a US-based eCommerce company with 4 brands in the functional botanical and wellness space (kratom, kava, alcohol-alternative drinks). Our products fall into restricted advertising categories on platforms like Meta and TikTok, which means standard ad strategies do not work for us.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Paid Acquisition Specialist/Paid Ads Strategist who has specific experience running ads for products in restricted or gray market categories. If you have only run ads for standard eCommerce products, this may not be the right fit. We need someone who understands compliance-focused advertising, bridge funnels, and how to scale paid media without getting accounts shut down.



DAY-TO-DAY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Plan and execute paid ad campaigns across Meta, TikTok, native ad networks, and alternative platforms

- Build and maintain bridge funnels: pre-sell pages, education-first landing pages, multi-step opt-in sequences

- Develop ad angles that drive clicks without triggering platform violations

- Manage multi-domain setups to protect brand assets from platform bans

- Create creative briefs and ad angle direction for our graphic design team

- Monitor platform policy changes and adapt campaigns proactively

- Track performance metrics: CAC, ROAS, CPL, conversion rates

- Provide weekly performance reports with clear action items and optimization plans

- Test and evaluate alternative advertising platforms and channels



REQUIREMENTS

- Experience running paid ads for restricted or gray market products (supplements, CBD, kratom, kava, alcohol alternatives, or similar). This is required, not optional.

- Knowledge of bridge funnel construction and multi-domain setups for compliance

- Experience with Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and at least one alternative ad platform

- Strong analytical skills — you make decisions based on data

- Good English communication for reporting and creative briefs

- Familiarity with direct response advertising and funnel-based marketing



WHAT WE PROVIDE

- A portfolio of 4 brands with established products and existing customer bases

- Graphic design team to produce ad creatives based on your direction

- Strategic direction and clear KPIs

- Long-term engagement with increasing responsibility as campaigns scale

- Flexible schedule with reasonable overlap during US business hours (Central Time)



TO APPLY

1. Please include in your application:

- Your specific experience with restricted-category advertising (which products, which platforms)

- Examples of bridge funnels or compliance-focused ad strategies you have used

- How you have handled or prevented ad account suspensions in the past

- Any metrics from restricted-category campaigns you can share

- Experience building content strategies for eCommerce or DTC brands

Familiarity with Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging platforms

- Experience in wellness, supplements, or health-related brands is a strong plus

title: WordPress Technical Lead - Launch, QA & Maintenance (Long-Term, Brisbane Agency)
description:
WordPress Technical Lead - Launch, QA & Maintenance (Long-Term, Brisbane Agency)

About us

We're a small, family-run web design agency based in Brisbane, Australia. We build WordPress sites for local businesses - mostly using Elementor Pro, hosted on SiteGround. We're growing, and we're looking for one reliable, genuinely skilled person to take ownership of the technical side of our projects so we can focus on bringing in new work.

This is not a data-entry or general VA role. We need a real WordPress developer who knows the platform deeply and can be trusted to work inside our systems without hand-holding.

We're after a long-term relationship, not a one-off job. If this works well, there's a clear path to ongoing retainer work and potentially full-time - we'd much rather find one great person and keep them than constantly rehire.

What you'll do

You'll be our second set of expert eyes and our go-to technical person. Our builds are done by a separate developer - your job is to review, polish, launch and maintain. Day to day, that means:



Reviewing completed builds before they go live - checking every page, link and element is working and looks 100% right

Taking sites live properly, with no broken links, missing redirects or surprises

Setting up and managing SiteGround hosting and making sure everything runs cleanly

Checking all plugins are installed, configured and working correctly

Handling technical SEO - schema markup, meta setup, indexing, site health

Adding internal and external links where it helps the site

Planning and running URL migrations for redesign projects - mapping old URLs to new ones and setting up 301 redirects so we don't lose traffic or rankings

Being the person we can contact when something breaks - diagnosing and fixing issues across the WordPress / Elementor / SiteGround stack

As we grow, there may also be opportunity to take on full site builds yourself - so if you're a strong builder as well as a reviewer, tell us



Who you are



Strong, proven experience building and maintaining WordPress sites

Confident with Elementor Pro specifically

Comfortable working inside SiteGround (not just wp-admin) - hosting, staging, server-level basics

You understand technical SEO and schema, and can explain what you're doing in plain English

You've done website migrations before and understand how to protect traffic and rankings

Reliable, honest about timelines, and good at communicating - if something's wrong, you tell us early

Available during some overlap with Brisbane business hours (AEST) for when issues come up



The arrangement



We'll start hourly on a small trial project or two so we can both see if it's a good fit

From there, we move to ongoing work - a monthly block of hours for launches and support, plus project work as it comes

This starts at around 10-15 hours a week, but that's a starting point, not a cap. We're growing, and for the right person there's genuine scope for the hours to increase over time - potentially toward full-time. If you can build sites as well as review them, that's exactly the kind of person we want to grow with

Rate is $9/hr USD to start, with room to grow as the role does. We're not chasing the cheapest option - we'd rather pay fairly for someone we can trust and keep

You'll have your own secure logins (we use a password manager) and we'll ask you to sign a simple NDA, since you'll have access to our clients' sites



How to apply

We read every application properly, so please take a few minutes with yours. Generic copy-paste applications will be ignored.



Start your reply with the word MORETON so we know you've read this whole post.

In a short paragraph, tell us how you'd approach migrating a website to a new design without losing search traffic - specifically how you handle the old URLs.

Send links to 2-3 WordPress sites you've built or worked on, and briefly say what your role was on each.

Tell us your experience with SiteGround and Elementor Pro specifically.



Looking forward to meeting you.

title: Senior Amazon Specialist
description:
Senior Amazon Operations Specialist

Company: Velomix 



Job Overview



We are looking for a Senior Amazon Operations Specialist to join Velomix and take ownership of our day-to-day Amazon engine. Velomix is a high-performance, innovation-driven fitness brand and the #1 best-selling protein shaker brand on Amazon US, now expanding into supplements and digital products.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who already knows Amazon inside out and wants to own results — not wait for step-by-step instructions.



Key Responsibilities

• Own daily Seller Central operations across marketplaces (US first; CA/EU as needed): listings, variations, catalog hygiene, account health, and policy compliance.

• Lead problem-solving on critical issues: suppressions, NCX, stranded/inactive SKUs, voice-of-customer, buy box, listing changes, hijackers, etc.

• Coordinate with the inventory/supply-chain team on FBA/AWD shipments, restock plans, and stock-out risk; maintain clear reorder and launch calendars.

• Manage and improve listing quality: images, copy, A+ content, brand store, and keywords — working with design, content, and PPC teams.

• Monitor performance and spot opportunities: sessions, CVR, CTR, TACoS inputs, SQP, pricing, and promo calendar.

• Create and maintain SOPs, checklists, and dashboards so the system runs smoothly and can be delegated to junior tea
mbers.

• Mentor and quality-check work of Junior Amazon Specialists and VAs.

• Drive and report weekly: key metrics, issues, root causes, and proposed fixes.



Skills & Experience

• 2+ years managing Amazon Seller Central for private label brands (PL model) with a strong track record in operations and catalog management.

• Deep familiarity with tools like Helium 10, Keepa, Sellerboard, and Amazon Business Reports; strong skills in Google Sheets/Excel.

• Confident handling: listing creation/variation, flat files, cases with Seller Support, FBA/AWD workflow, and account health.

• Data-driven mindset: able to pull numbers, interpret them, and turn them into clear actions.

• Excellent written and spoken English (upper-intermediate or higher).

• Fast, reliable internet and a solid laptop suitable for daily Amazon work.

• Personality: ownership-driven, proactive, low-ego, comfortable working remotely with minimal micromanagement.



Why Join Velomix?

• Work at a fast-growing, data-driven brand with real category leadership on Amazon.

• Senior role with clear impact on revenue, profit, and customer experience.

• Competitive salary, with growth based on performance and ownership.

• Remote work with flexible hours, collaborating with a global team.

title: Growth & Business Development Lead
description:
The Company



Hire Anywhere helps UK businesses hire exceptional full-time remote talent in the Philippines through a proper headhunting model, not a freelancer marketplace.



We work closely with founders and growing businesses to help them build reliable overseas teams across operations, finance, marketing support, customer support, and executive support roles.



We’re a small founder-led business with strong delivery capability and happy clients. What we’re now focused on is building the demand side of the business properly.



The Opportunity



We’re looking for a commercially-minded growth and outbound operator to help us build a more consistent pipeline of qualified founder conversations.



This is not a traditional marketing role focused purely on content, paid ads, or social media management.



Instead, this role is about helping us:

- create qualified conversations with founders

- improve how we position the business

- build outbound systems and workflows

- refine messaging over time

- and help create a more repeatable demand engine



You’ll work closely with the founders and have meaningful ownership over shaping the outbound and growth side of the business.



What The Work Looks Like



Some of the work will involve:

- building target account lists

- writing outbound
 and LinkedIn messaging

- setting up outreach workflows and tooling

- helping improve LinkedIn visibility and positioning

- refining messaging based on response data

- coordinating qualified discovery calls

- tracking outreach and pipeline activity

- identifying ways to improve trust and conversion throughout the process



A large part of the challenge is trust and communication.



Many business owners are interested in overseas hiring, but are unsure whether:

- communication will work smoothly

- the quality will be high

- the process will feel professional

- overseas hiring is realistic for a smaller business



We’re looking for someone who understands how to bridge that gap through thoughtful outreach, positioning, and communication.



Who We Think Will Do Well In This Role



This role will likely suit someone who enjoys building things from scratch and is excited by the idea of helping shape the demand side of a growing business. We’re looking for someone who thinks commercially, communicates clearly, and is comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution.



You’re probably proactive, resourceful, and naturally inclined to improve systems, messaging, and processes rather than simply following instructions. You enjoy figuring things out, testing ideas, and refining what works over time, especially in founder-led or early-stage environments where there’s room to build.



You may have experience in areas such as outbound lead generation, pipeline building, business development, startup growth operations, agency growth, high-trust B2B service sales, or early-stage SaaS. Experience within recruitment, staffing, or adjacent service-based businesses is helpful, but not essential.



Most importantly, we’re looking for someone who takes ownership, enjoys solving commercial problems, and wants to play a meaningful role in helping grow the business.



Work Setup

- Part-time / fractional role

- Roughly 2–3 days per week to start

- UK hours; overlap preferred

- Flexible long-term opportunity for the right person

Please apply through the Zoho Forms link below and tell us a bit about your experience:

title: Salesforce Administrator
description:
ROLE DESCRIPTION: Salesforce Administrator

Department: Customer Success

Reports to: Head of Customer Success 



Role Purpose: 

The purpose of this role is to enhance how Visualcare uses Salesforce across the Sales, Customer Success, and Help Desk teams. Partnering closely with these teams, this role assesses how each function uses the platform day-to-day, identifies opportunities to improve workflows, and designs and builds the automations, dashboards, and data structures needed to support efficient, data-driven operations. This role plays an important part in ensuring Salesforce is well configured, well used, and trusted as the single source of truth for customer, lead, and account information at Visualcare, and works with leadership across Sales and Customer Success to ensure platform investment translates into measurable business outcomes.



What are the requirements/credentials of an ideal candidate

• 4+ years working hands-on with Salesforce in a configuration, administration, or build capacity, ideally within a SaaS or technology-driven environment

• Demonstrated experience customising Salesforce — including building flows, process automations, validation rules, page layouts, custom objects, and approval processes

• Strong skills in designing and building dashboards and reports that support day-to-day operations and leadership decision-making across multiple business functions

• Experience partnering with Sales, Customer Success, and/or Customer Support teams to understand their workflows and translate operational needs into well-scoped Salesforce solutions

• Proven experience managing data quality in Salesforce — including data audits, deduplication, cleansing, and lead/contact enrichment

• Salesforce Administrator certification - Advanced Administrator, Service Cloud Consultant, Sales Cloud Consultant, or Platform App Builder certifications highly regarded

• Systems thinker with a strong workflow orientation — able to map how work flows across people, processes, and tools, and design solutions that hold up at scale

• High attention to detail with a disciplined approach to testing, documentation, and change management

• Excellent communication skills — able to partner with non-technical stakeholders, understand their workflows, and translate requirements into clear technical solutions

• Comfortable working across competing priorities from multiple business functions, with the ability to triage and sequence work transparently



?

Key Areas of Focus: 

* Workflow Discovery & Solution Design (30%)

-Partner with the Sales, Customer Success, and Help Desk teams to understand how each function uses Salesforce on a day-to-day basis.

-Identify workflow inefficiencies, operational gaps, and opportunities for process improvement across teams.

Recommend practical and scalable Salesforce solutions aligned with business needs and priorities.

Document both current-state and future-state workflows clearly for stakeholder alignment and ongoing business reference.



*Salesforce Configuration & Automation (35%)

-Build and configure Salesforce solutions including flows, automations, validation rules, custom objects, and page layouts.

Implement workflow enhancements that reduce manual processes and improve operational efficiency across Sales, Customer Success, and Help Desk functions.



-Apply structured testing and change management processes to ensure system stability and user adoption.

Maintain clear technical documentation for all configurations, automations, and system enhancements.



* Reporting & Dashboards (20%)

- Design and develop dashboards and reports that provide visibility into operational and team performance.

-Translate business and operational requirements into actionable reporting solutions such as pipeline tracking, customer health monitoring, ticket volume analysis, and resolution metrics.

-Ensure Salesforce data is properly structured to support accurate and meaningful reporting.

-Continuously optimize dashboards and reports based on evolving business priorities and KPIs.



*Data Cleansing & Enrichment (15%)

-Conduct regular Salesforce data audits to identify duplicates, inconsistencies, and data quality issues.

-Lead ongoing data cleansing initiatives to maintain Salesforce as a reliable source of truth.

-Enrich customer and lead records with relevant supporting data to improve targeting, segmentation, and reporting accuracy.

-Establish and maintain data quality standards, naming conventions, and governance processes to ensure long-term data integrity.



?

Success measures

• Salesforce workflows across Sales, Customer Success, and Help Desk are continuously improved, with regular delivery of scoped, well-tested enhancements

• Dashboards and reports are actively used by each business function and leadership for day-to-day decision-making

• Measurable improvements in operational efficiency (e.g. reduction in manual handling, improved resolution times, improved pipeline visibility) against baselines agreed with each team

• Salesforce data quality is consistently maintained — duplicates, gaps, and stale records reduced over time against agreed standards

• Customer and lead records are appropriately enriched to support segmentation, targeting, and reporting

• Strong, trusted working partnerships with the Sales, Customer Success, and Help Desk teams, with clear and transparent prioritisation of competing requests

title: Senior Video Editor — Performance Marketing
description:
Senior Video Editor — Performance Marketing



Company: Bublishing LLC / Ancient Remedies

Team: Performance Creative Team

Role Type: Full-time

Experience Required: Minimum 5 years



As a fast-growing natural health and wellness company, Ancient Remedies empowers people to take charge of their well-being through holistic medicine. We create beautifully crafted, practical books focusing on herbal remedies, food as medicine, and natural healing.



About the Role



We’re looking for a Senior Video Editor to join our Performance Marketing team and help create high-performing ads for a fast-scaling DTC health and wellness brand.



This is not a traditional video editing role. Can edit fast without becoming sloppy — speed and quality both matter here.



We need someone who understands that performance editing is not just about making videos look good — it’s about creating videos that hold attention, communicate clearly, build trust, and convert.



The ideal candidate is highly skilled in both traditional editing and AI-powered creative workflows. You should be comfortable working with AI-generated assets, organic footage, UGC-style content, and performance creative briefs. You should also understand pacing, retention, scroll-stopping hooks, pattern interrupts, and how editing decisions impact ad performance.



This person will be one of the strongest editors on the team and will work closely with the Lead Video Editor to improve creative quality, support the editing team, organize tools/assets, and help raise the overall standard of performance creative production.



Key Responsibilities



Performance Video Editing

• Edit high-converting ads for Meta, TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other paid social platforms.

• Create performance-driven edits using a mix of AI-generated assets, UGC content, stock footage, motion graphics, voiceovers, and organic clips.

• Build strong openings, scroll-stopping hooks, pattern interrupts, and retention-focused sequences.

• Edit with a deep understanding of pacing, clarity, emotional pull, and conversion intent.

• Adapt edits based on creative strategy, ad performance, and feedback from Creative Strategists and Media Buyers.

• Produce multiple variations and iterations of winning ads quickly.



AI-Powered Editing & Creative Workflows

• Use AI tools to create, enhance, and iterate video assets.

• Work with tools such as VEO3, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Seedance, Runway, Kling AI, and similar AI video/audio platforms.

• Create realistic AI-driven video outputs with attention to natural lip sync, voice matching, facial expressions, and believable human-like performances.

• Use prompting techniques to generate stronger AI assets, scenes, voices, characters, and visual sequences.

• Stay updated on the latest AI video tools, trends, workflows, and viral content formats.

• Help the team improve AI-assisted production speed and quality.



Creative Quality & Performance Standards

• Understand what makes an ad perform from an editing perspective.

• Analyze winning ads and apply creative insights into future edits.

• Identify what editing patterns, hooks, pacing, and formats are working.

• Help improve the quality and consistency of creative output across the team.

• Ensure videos are clear, polished, platform-native, and aligned with performance goals.

• Maintain fast turnaround times without sacrificing quality.



Team Support & Leadership

• Work closely with the Lead Video Editor to support the performance editing team.

• Help mentor, guide, and provide feedback to junior/mid-level editors when needed.

• Support quality control across edits before they move forward.

• Help organize tools, workflows, assets, references, and editing resources.

• Assist in improving editing processes, creative standards, and team efficiency.

• Act as a strong senior presence within the editing team.



Technical Requirements

• Minimum 5 years of professional video editing experience.

• Advanced proficiency in performance video editing for paid social ads.

• Strong experience with AI-powered video creation and editing workflows.

• Fast editing speed is required. This role requires someone who can move quickly, produce high-quality edits under tight timelines, and keep up with a high-volume performance marketing environment.

• Hands-on experience with tools such as:

  - VEO3

  - HeyGen

  - ElevenLabs

  - Seedance

  - Runway

  - Kling AI

  - or similar AI video/audio tools

• Strong understanding of:

  - AI prompting

  - natural lip sync

  - voice cloning

  - facial expressions

  - realistic AI human performances

  - AI-generated scenes and characters

• Strong understanding of:

  - retention editing

  - pacing

  - scroll-stopping hooks

  - pattern interrupts

  - engagement-driven storytelling

  - direct-response editing

• Experience editing short-form ads for:

  -

  - Instagram Reels

  - TikTok

  - YouTube Shorts

• Ability to work with both AI-generated and organic assets.

• Ability to deliver high-quality edits quickly and consistently.



Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working in performance marketing, DTC, e-commerce, supplements, health/wellness, or direct-response advertising.

• Experience managing, mentoring, or supporting a team of editors.

• Experience analyzing winning ads and translating insights into stronger edits.

• Strong understanding of creative testing and iteration.

• Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with Creative Strategists, Media Buyers, and other editors.

• Highly proactive, accountable, organized, and detail-oriented.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume creative environment.

• Strong taste level and ability to balance performance with quality.



What Success Looks Like



A successful Senior Video Editor will:

• Consistently produce high-performing video ads.

• Improve the quality and speed of the editing team.

• Help turn creative briefs into polished, conversion-focused ads.

• Use AI tools effectively to increase production speed and creative possibilities.

• Understand why certain ads win and apply those learnings to future edits.

• Help the Lead Video Editor maintain high standards across the team.

• Contribute to a stronger, faster, and more scalable creative production system.



Who This Role Is For



This role is for someone who is not just a “good editor,” but someone who understands how editing directly impacts ad performance.



You should be someone who:

• Cares about results, not just aesthetics.

• Can move fast without being sloppy.

• Has strong creative instincts.

• Knows how to use AI tools effectively.

• Can take feedback without ego.

• Can help raise the standard of the team.

• Wants to be part of a high-performing creative engine.



Who This Role Is Not For



This role is not for someone who:

• Only edits long-form content or brand videos.

• Struggles to keep up with fast turnaround times or needs too much time to complete standard performance ad edits.

• Needs constant direction for every small decision.

• Is not comfortable using AI tools.

• Does not understand paid social ads.

• Prioritizes aesthetics over performance.

• Struggles with fast turnaround times.

• Avoids feedback or iteration.

• Cannot work in a high-volume creative environment.



Application Requirements



Please include:

mbers to implement SEO recommendations



**Requirements**



* Proven experience in SEO, preferably across ecommerce, SaaS, and agency/client accounts

* Strong understanding of AI SEO, GEO, AEO, semantic SEO, and entity-based optimisation

* Experience with Shopify SEO

* Ability to manage multiple client SEO portfolios independently

* Strong technical SEO knowledge, including site structure, indexing, crawlability, schema, and page speed

* Experience using tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, SurferSEO, or similar

**Bonus Skills**



* Experience optimising websites for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, or AI search visibility

* Experience with ecommerce conversion optimisation

* Experience with programmatic SEO

**Role Structure**



* Part-time role initially

* Remote working arrangement

* Flexible hours

* Opportunity to transition into a full-time role based on positive performance

* Potential to grow into a senior SEO/GEO strategist role



**Ideal Candidate**



We are looking for someone who is proactive, analytical, technical, and genuinely interested in the future of search.

-File upload and attachment flows.

-AI Adaptability: Enthusiasm for and experience with using AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor) to speed up coding tasks.

-Languages: Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript

-Infrastructure: Self-Hosted Node.js environments, REST APIs, External DBs (Supabase/Firebase/etc.)

Frontend: React (Admin UI)



Nice to Have

-Proven Wix Experience:

-Building Wix CLI projects.

-Using Wix SDK and Platform APIs (Stores, eCommerce, OAuth).

-Implementing Wix Service Plugins and SPIs.

-Reliability: Experience with logging, monitoring, and error tracking tools.

If you’re good, fast, reliable, and follow instructions properly, there is real potential to grow into a stable full-time role with us.

title: Construction and Maintenance Coordinator
description:
Join Haverton Homes



Haverton Homes is a Sydney-based residential builder committed to delivering quality homes and a seamless client experience — from the first contract signing through to long after handover. We're a tight-knit team that values accountability, clear communication, and getting things done properly the first time.



About the Role



This role owns three critical touchpoints in the client journey: preparing projects for construction, keeping clients informed through the preconstruction and approval stages, and resolving any defect or maintenance matters that arise after handover.



You'll sit at the intersection of sales, design, certification, and trades — making sure projects are construction-ready on time and that every post-handover issue is handled with professionalism and care. This is a coordination-heavy role with a lot of moving parts, and success comes down to your ability to stay organised, communicate clearly, and follow through relentlessly.



Key Responsibilities

• Track preconstruction milestones and chase outstanding items to keep projects moving

• Keep clients informed through the approval stage with weekly updates on progress

• Liaise with sales, accounts, drafting, estimating, and site supervisors as required

• Upload occupation certificate documentation within one business day

• Receive, log, and triage all incoming defect and maintenance requests by urgency and warranty status

• Engage and schedule subcontractors and suppliers for warranty call-outs

• Follow up persistently until every defect item is resolved and signed off

• Acknowledge every client request within one business day and manage escalated conversations with empathy

• Maintain accurate records across monday.com, SharePoint, On-Site Companion, BuildCert Portal, and Databuild

• Produce regular reporting on the preconstruction pipeline and open defects



What We're Looking For



Essential:

• Minimum 2 years in a similar coordination, construction administration, or client services role, with preference given to those with experience in the Australian residential construction market

• Proven ability to follow and maintain checklists and workflows without cutting corners

• Strong written and verbal communication — particularly with clients, certifiers, and trades

• Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

• Confident chasing people for responses and holding others accountable

• Proficient with Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Excel, Teams, SharePoint)



Desirable:

• Familiarity with monday.com, On-Site Companion, BuildCert Portal, Databuild, or DocuSign

• Understanding of HIA and building warranty obligations

• Comfortable using AI tools such as Claude or Copilot to streamline admin tasks



You'll thrive in this role if you're calm under pressure, take ownership of problems through to resolution, and hold yourself to a high standard in your written communications.



Why Join Haverton Homes?

• Work on quality residential projects with a team that takes pride in the homes they deliver. 

• Be part of a growing company with a strong pipeline and a supportive, close-knit culture. 

• Opportunities for career progression and continuous learning as the business expands. 

• A collaborative environment where you'll have direct access to decision-makers and your contributions genuinely matter.

title: Creative Strategist & Content Producer
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.

Job description

We're looking for a Creative Strategist & Content Producer to shape how our health & pharmaceutical brands communicate across both digital & offline channels. You'll craft effective strategies that translate scientific credibility into compelling storytelling & creative assets - helping us engage our diverse audience as we expand our presence regionally. 



The Creative Strategist & Content Producer will be the visionary link between our brand identity, compelling content creation & drive measurable performance across all key channels. This role is responsible for developing & testing high-impact creative strategies as well as producing content assets (visual, video, copy) internally, specifically designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates, lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee & Lazada stores via social media as well as paid advertising platforms.



You'll work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the new channels of the business. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry. 



Key Responsibilities:

Creative Strategy

- Platform & Channel Strategy: Craft tailored creative strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific best practices & formats that align with brand goals & regulatory requirements in each market (e.g., Meta carousel ads, vertical video for TikTok/Reels, static product carousels for Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banner ads).

- Hypothesis Generation & A/B Testing: Develop robust creative testing matrices, formulate clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, calls-to-action, visual styles, copy length) that drive measurable improvements in Click-Through Rate (CTR) & Conversion Rate (CVR).

- Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion).

- Competitive Analysis: Continuously keep up to date with competitors & industry trends, identifying new & successful creative formats, hooks & messaging to finetune our strategy.

In-House Content Production & Execution 

- Performance Creative Development: Lead the end-to-end creative concept development & production for all organic & paid media campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube, etc.) that align with brand & campaign goals, focusing on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing required for performance marketing.

- Hands-on Asset Creation: Directly produce & edit native social content & performance ads using existing assets, stock libraries & internal resources. This includes:

i. Plan platform-specific content calendars: Cover educational, promotional & corporate communications

ii. Static/Image Editing: Adapt product photography, create ad variations & design simple graphics & banner ads

iii. Video Editing: Fast-paced assembly, cutting, adding text overlays, music & effects for short-form, vertical video (UGC-style, product demos, testimonials)

- Copywriting: Develop high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & social media captions that align with the creative strategy & brand voice, with a focus on clear value propositions & strong CTAs.

- Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across relevant channels (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada store fronts & advertising platforms).

- Testing & Optimization: apply insights & analytics to refine & optimize content effectiveness across platforms.

Performance & Reporting

- Data-Driven Insights: Work closely with the Marketing Manager to analyze creative performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving results (or failing) across Shopify, Shopee & Lazada traffic.

- Iteration & Optimization: 

i. Develop, adapt or review content & formats to improve engagement & performance

ii. Use performance data (ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR) to rapidly iterate on existing creative assets & inform future strategy, ensuring a continuous cycle of improvement & optimization

Storefront Integration: Integrate winning creative messages & visuals onto the respective e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a cohesive customer journey.

Multi-Channel Storytelling

- Content cohesion: Ensure content is aligned where possible across digital & print media, including LinkedIn, Instagram,
, YouTube, e-commerce platforms, brochures & trade materials.

- Tailor content: To achieve relevance & effectiveness across different stages of the audience journey — from brand awareness & education to conversion.

- Storytelling & visual consistency: To strengthen brand trust & recognition.

Compliance & Brand Integrity

- Uphold regulatory & ethical communication standards across all marketing activities.

- Ensure all content complies with regulatory guidelines & marketing requirements in each country we operate in, including product claims, advertising language & digital promotions.

- Maintain brand credibility by ensuring all communications are factual & aligned with company values.

- Collaborate with internal teams to review materials for accuracy, effectiveness & compliance before publication.



Requirements:

- 3–5 years of experience in creative strategy, content creation, social media, or brand marketing — ideally in health supplements, healthcare or wellness.

- Strong understanding of social media trends & platform best practices (Meta (FB/IG), LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Google, Generative AI).

- Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro), CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar tools.

- Excellent writing, editing & visual storytelling skills — adopt a strategic approach to design that integrates marketing & commercial goals.

- Excellent communication, project management & cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Familiarity with regulatory communication standards or track record in health supplements or healthcare industry is a plus.

 your complete application package to

title: Financial Operations Manager (Commercial Accounting / Full-Cycle / Xero / CPA Preferred / Manila Based)
description:
Job Description



Company: Priority Haulage Limited

Job Title: Financial Operations Manager

Job Type: Part-Time

Job Hours: ~25 Hours Per Week

Job Location:  Remote (Manila-based candidates only)

Reports to: Financial Controller

Start Date: Immediately



About Priority Haulage



Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. 



Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence.



Job Summary



Priority Haulage is seeking a reliable and capable Financial Operations Manager to oversee day-to-day finance operations and support the monthly close process within a lean, systems-focused environment.



This is a hands-on role focused on maintaining accurate financial records, supporting month-end reporting, and ensuring finance workflows operate smoothly and efficiently.



Role Overview 



This role suits someone organised, dependable, systems-minded, and comfortable working autonomously within a structured operational environment.



Availability & Working Hours

This role requires consistent daily coverage during New Zealand morning business hours, with a structured morning schedule and flexible, outcome-focused afternoon support. Philippine Time (PHT) is typically 4 hours behind NZT (5 hours during NZ daylight saving).



Core Daily Hours (NZT)

9:00 AM – 12:00 PM NZT (5:00 AM – 8:00 AM PHT)

These hours are required each business day and cover core financial operations, daily processing, reconciliations, payroll coordination, and communication with the New Zealand team.



The operational finance workload during this period is expected to be manageable within these core hours under normal operating conditions.



Month-End & Management Accounts Cycle

Additional hours are required during the monthly close process.



This includes:



• Close preparation during the final 1–2 business days of the month; and

• Completion of the monthly management accounts package within 8 working days following month-end.



During this period, responsibilities include:



• Reconciliations

• Working papers

• Management accounts preparation

• Review updates

• Close-related coordination



This workload is expected to average approximately 20–25 hours per month depending on the cycle and business activity.



Flexible Support & Process Improvement

Outside core operational and month-end responsibilities, additional flexible hours may be available to support:



• Finance process improvements

• Reporting and documentation enhancements

• Workflow optimisation

• Additional reconciliation and operational finance support as required



These hours will be agreed based on operational priorities and the successful candidate’s capability and availability.



Job Responsibilities



Bookkeeping & Financial Operations

• Perform day-to-day bookkeeping activities in Xero.

• Manage the general ledger and maintain the chart of accounts.

• Complete all required financial reconciliations accurately and on time.



Payroll Administration

• Review approved driver timesheets.

• Process weekly payroll, submit payments, and manage IRD filings.

• Ensure payroll accuracy and compliance with New Zealand standards.



Supplier Management

• Manage supplier accounts, payments, reconciliations, and resolve queries.

• Coordinate subcontractor bills and ensure accurate reconciliation.

• Oversee recurring subscriptions, licensing, registrations, and compliance costs.



Client Management

• Issue client statements and prepare, manage, and communicate job quotations.

• Resolve client account, billing, and payment enquiries.

• Support accounts receivable and debt collection activities via the Client Services Coordinator.



Operational Support & Continuous Improvement

• Drive process improvements, system optimisation, and efficiency opportunities.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to support timely, high-quality workflows.

• Partner with leadership to ensure accurate, reliable finance data.



Reporting & Compliance

• Prepare monthly management accounts, reconciliations, and reporting using Xero and CCH Workpapers, ensuring accuracy and timely month-end close. 

• Support GST preparation and adherence to New Zealand accounting standards. 

• Maintain financial data integrity, documentation standards, and contribute to ongoing reporting improvements.



Required Experience & Capability



Applicants should demonstrate proven experience operating in a structured, deadline-driven finance environment.

• Minimum 7+ years’ hands-on accounting experience.

• CPA qualification required, preferably a Regular Member of PICPA, with a recognised tertiary qualification in accounting.

• Advanced proficiency in Xero is essential.

• Strong Microsoft Excel capability, with proven ability to reconcile and analyse data using XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, and financial modelling functions.

• Proven experience preparing monthly management accounts, conducting financial analysis, and supporting budgeting and forecasting activities.

• Working knowledge of New Zealand tax regulations, accounting standards, and statutory compliance requirements.

• Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote environment, with strong self-management, reliability, and a consistent track record of meeting deadlines without oversight.

• Strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally, supporting finance-related workflows across the business.

• High level of technical proficiency, including the Microsoft platform, with working familiarity in modern business tools.



Preferred Experience 



• Experience within New Zealand or Australian Chartered Accounting firms, including use of CCH Workpapers.

• Exposure to a commercial business environment, ideally within transport, logistics, or fleet-based operations.

• Experience using Notion, ChatGPT, and modern workflow/documentation tools within an operational business environment.

• A relevant tertiary qualification in finance, business administration, or a related field.



Personal Attributes



• Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities reliably.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to operate autonomously while contributing effectively in a remote team environment.

• Analytical and problem-solving capability, particularly in identifying, investigating, and resolving financial discrepancies.

• Proactive and improvement-oriented, with the ability to adapt, optimise workflows, and navigate operational change.

• Professional, client-focused mindset, demonstrating integrity, quality standards, and accountability in delivery.



Required Equipment and Setup



• Dedicated Workspace: Quiet, distraction-free home office suitable for video calls and focused work.

• Computer & Internet: Desktop PC or laptop with minimum Intel Core i5 processor, 8GB RAM (16GB preferred), Windows 10/11 compatibility, and a stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 10 Mbps upload/download).

• Monitor Setup: Dual monitors, or a laptop paired with an external monitor.

• Headset: Noise-cancelling headset for clear communication during virtual meetings where operating outside a fully quiet workspace.

• Webcam: High-quality external or integrated camera for video calls.

• Power Backup: Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or generator ensuring at least 3 hours of operational uptime during outages.

• Internet Backup: Secondary internet connection (e.g., mobile data or alternative wireless) for uninterrupted connectivity.



Application Requirement

In your application submission, include the word “Motivated!” in the title.

title: DTC CREATIVE STRATEGIST
description:
We're an Australian beauty brand doing $500K/month. By 2027, we'll be at $2M/month, expanding into new markets, new channels, new angles that nobody in our category is running.

We don't need someone to "help with creative." We need the person who becomes the reason our ads print money.



WHAT THIS ACTUALLY IS



You'll own the entire creative pipeline. Not just briefs, but the thinking that makes briefs dangerous.

Mine for gold in Reddit threads, Amazon reviews, TikTok comments, customer calls. You'll find the emotional triggers our competitors are sleeping on and turn them into angles that stop cold traffic dead.

Testing hooks to CTAs, every frame earns the next second. You'll write for UGC creators and our other video editors who will report directly to you. YOU are the one running your own team alongside our founder.

Brief with precision. Your briefs shouldn't leave room for guesswork. Editors execute because your direction is that clear.

Read the data, find the signal. You'll live inside the ad account with our founder. Hook rate, hold rate, CPA, ROAS. You'll know exactly why something worked and feed that insight straight back into the next round of tests.

Scale what wins. When an angle hits, you don't celebrate. You spin 10 variations and push harder before fatigue sets in.

Test at volume. We move fast. You'll be pushing multiple new concepts per week across Meta, TikTok, and emerging platforms as we enter new markets.

This isn't a "make it pretty" role. This is a "make it convert" role with a direct line to revenue.



WHO THIS IS FOR

You've done this before. You've scaled creative at a DTC brand or agency and you can point to the ads that worked and tell us why.



You:



Have 2+ years in direct response creative strategy, ideally in beauty, skincare, wellness, or health in competitive paid social environments

Understand Meta and TikTok creative strategy at a deep level: hooks, angles, formats, fatigue cycles, platform nuance

Can write ad scripts that convert cold traffic, not just entertain warm audiences

Obsess over creative performance data. You pull insights, not just reports

Communicate sharp and fast. Your briefs are tight, your Slack messages are clear, your feedback loops are closed the same day

Have experience (or serious hunger) working across international markets like AU, US, UK, and beyond

Want to grow into a Creative Director or Head of Creative role as we scale. This is a ground-floor seat at a brand going from strong to dominant

Treat this like it's your brand. You show up like an owner, not an employee



Bonus points:



You've worked in the Australian or APAC beauty market

You have experience scaling into the US or UK from a non-US base

You understand influencer and UGC ecosystems across multiple markets

You've used AI tools to accelerate creative workflows



WHO THIS IS NOT FOR



If you need to be told what to test, don't apply

If you take 3 days to turn around a brief, don't apply

If blunt feedback makes you spiral, don't apply

If you've never worked on ads that had real spend behind them, don't apply

If you think "strategy" means a deck with no execution, don't apply

If you want a coasting gig with no accountability, this will eat you alive



COMPENSATION

Base: $1,000/week ($4,333/month)

Plus uncapped bonuses on every winning ad.

Your ads scale, you earn more. There is no ceiling. The structure rewards volume, quality, and results. The trifecta that separates strategists from brief-fillers.

We'll also invest in your growth: courses, masterminds, tools. Whatever makes you sharper, we'll cover it.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We're at $500K/month with a product that converts and a brand that resonates. The creative engine is what takes us to $2M/month and beyond, across multiple markets. You won't be inheriting someone else's playbook. You'll be writing it.

One seat. Long-term. If you're the right strategist, you'll look back on this as the role that changed everything.

TO APPLY

Send us:



A short Loom (under 3 minutes) breaking down one ad you've created or strategised that crushed it. What was the angle, why it worked, and what you'd test next.

Your portfolio or examples of ads you've been responsible for (strategy, scripts, or both)

A one-paragraph answer: What's the first thing you'd do in your first week with us?



No cover letters. No CVs full of job titles. Show us how you think.

title: AI Automation Specialist
description:
Role Purpose

We have already built the foundations of an AI-driven operating system, including an internal Topweld quoting skill, a 13-machine costing model with TCO-based rates, and standardised document formats. What we now need is an automation specialist who can wire these foundations into our day-to-day Microsoft 365 environment, so that
s, invoices, and quotes move through the business with minimal manual handling.

The role is delivery-focused. The successful candidate will work directly with the director, build automations inside Microsoft 365 using Power Automate and the Claude API, document every workflow as a written operating procedure, and transfer ownership to the internal team. No custom web apps, no separate databases, no bespoke development outside the Microsoft 365 stack.

Priority Workstreams

The role begins with three priority workstreams. The director's expectation is that each workstream is delivered, accepted, and handed over before the next begins, with a target of two weeks per workstream subject to feedback turnaround. Candidates are invited to propose a faster sequence if they can justify it.

Workstream 1 – Inbox Triage and Client Communications

Topweld receives RFQs, supplier correspondence, project updates, and internal traffic across two shared mailboxes 
 
 is rising as the business grows, and a structured triage layer is overdue.

– Deploy automated monitoring of both shared inboxes via Power Automate.

– Use the Claude API to classify each incoming
 into defined categories, including quote requests, supplier correspondence, active project communications, internal traffic, and noise.

– Issue branded auto-acknowledgements on quote requests and new client enquiries with realistic response time expectations set by the director.

– Maintain a live SharePoint register of classified
s with sender, subject, category, classification confidence, and timestamp for follow-up tracking.

– Define escalation behaviour for high-priority categories and an after-hours handling rule.

Acceptance Criteria

– Category classification accurate on at least 90 percent of a 50
 back-test.

– Auto-acknowledgement issued within 5 minutes of receipt for any qualifying
.

– Live register populated automatically, queryable, and visible to the director without manual intervention.

– Written operating procedure delivered, covering monitoring, pausing, retraining, and ownership transfer.

Workstream 2 – Supplier Document Intelligence

Topweld receives supplier invoices, delivery dockets, and purchase order confirmations daily, currently handled manually. The objective is to lift this data out of PDFs and into structured form for reconciliation, procurement tracking, and bookkeeping handoff.

– Build an extraction workflow for supplier invoices arriving via
 or saved to SharePoint, using the Claude API for parsing.

– Extract supplier name, invoice number, invoice date, line items, GST, freight, and total.

– Write extracted data into a structured Excel workbook organised by supplier and month.

– Flag any invoice with missing fields, low confidence on totals, or formatting anomalies into an exception register for manual review.

– Validate the workflow against a sample of at least 20 invoices spanning our active supplier base.

Acceptance Criteria

– Extraction accuracy of 95 percent or higher on supplier name and invoice total.

– End-to-end processing time of 10 minutes or less from inbox to Excel entry.

– Exception register operating reliably so no invoice is silently misread or skipped.

– Written operating procedure delivered, covering new supplier onboarding, exception review, and Excel structure maintenance.

Workstream 3 – Quoting Automation

Topweld already has an internal quoting skill and machine costing model covering 13 machines (press brake, fiber laser, bandsaw, guillotine, plate roller, section roller, orbital welder, lathe, mill, drill press, MIG/TIG/stick welding, auto-feeder TIG, angle grinder) with TCO-based rates. The objective is to wire this into a workflow that drafts quotes automatically from incoming RFQs and delivers them to the director for review.

title: Senior Meta Ads Media Buyer | Home Services (Roofing) | $1.5K Base + Commission
description:
Senior Meta Ads Media Buyer. Home Services Niche. Full-Time, Remote, Long-Term.



$1,500/month base plus commission. Realistic OTE $4,000 to $5,000+/month for top performance. Massive growth ceiling.



We're a US-based performance marketing agency running Meta ads for home service contractors. Roofing, HVAC, remodeling, exteriors, solar, and similar trades. Our model is fully performance-based. We only get paid when our clients get booked appointments. That means the quality of our media buying directly drives our revenue. There's no hiding behind retainers here.



We're scaling fast and we need a killer.



Not a beginner. Not someone "looking to grow into the role." A killer. Someone who already runs ad accounts like a weapon, who walks into a broken account and sees the problem in 10 minutes, who treats every dollar of client spend like it's their own.



The package



$1,500/month base. Paid reliably, on time, every month.



Performance commission on top. Tied to client results and retention.



Realistic earnings: $4,000 to $5,000+/month if you perform at the level we're hiring for.



No cap. The better the agency does, the better you do.



Real long-term growth. As we scale to 50+ accounts, you scale with us in pay, in scope, in equity of impact on the business.



This is a top-tier media buyer role on OnlineJobs.ph. The base is strong. The real money is in the commission, and we structured it that way on purpose. We want someone who's hungry, who wants to win, and who gets paid more the better they perform. If you just want a safe paycheck, this isn't the role.



You'll have a personal associate



You won't be running everything alone. You'll have a dedicated personal associate. Your right-hand. Someone who handles the executional work under your direction.



Think Harvey Specter and Mike Ross from Suits. You're Harvey. You think, you strategize, you lead, you make the calls that matter. Mike does the legwork, builds the cases, executes the tasks you assign, and learns from how you operate. Same dynamic here. You run the show, your associate makes you faster.



This is why managing experience matters. You need to know how to delegate, how to hold someone to a standard, and how to get leverage out of having a teammate instead of doing everything yourself.



Read this carefully



We will fully onboard you to our systems, our offer, our internal processes, how we report to clients, how we structure campaigns, and our specific playbook. You don't need to know our way of doing things on day one. We'll teach you that.



What you DO need to walk in with is the craft itself. You already know how to run Meta ads at a professional level. You already understand the home services buyer. You already know how to diagnose a broken account, how to structure tests, how to read data and make sharp decisions, how to brief creative, how to scale a winner without breaking it.



We're not teaching you Meta ads. We're not teaching you what a good CPL looks like for a roofer in Texas vs. Ohio. We're not teaching you why your CBO is underspending. If you have to Google it, this isn't your role.



What we ARE teaching you is how WE do things, what our clients expect, and how we win in our market. Big difference.



What you'll own



Strategy and execution across roughly 15 to 20 active home services ad accounts (scaling to 30 to 50+).



Diagnosing underperforming accounts and fixing them proactively, not reactively.



Creative, audience, and offer testing across multiple client markets.



Directing your personal associate. Assigning tasks, reviewing work, holding the bar.



Direct line to leadership. No middle layers, no bureaucracy.



Spotting platform shifts early and bringing solutions before problems hit.



Hard requirements. Don't apply without these.



Minimum 3 years running Meta ads for US home service contractors (roofing, HVAC, solar, remodeling, exteriors, windows, plumbing, painting, etc.). Ecom and SaaS experience doesn't count here.



Provable results. Case studies, screenshots, or live account access. Real numbers from real contractor accounts. No proof, no interview.



Fluent English. Written and spoken. You'll be on internal calls and directing your associate.



Real experience leading at least one other person in a marketing role.



Full-time availability with overlap with US business hours.



Deep understanding of the home services buyer. Insurance vs. retail leads, storm dynamics, what makes an appointment qualified vs. a tire-kicker that wastes the contractor's time.



Nice to have



GoHighLevel (GHL) experience.



Experience with AI and automated lead nurture systems.



Prior agency-side experience.



How to apply. Applications missing any of these will be ignored.



1. A 3 to 5 minute Loom video walking us through ONE home services ad account you've personally managed. Show:



The actual account (blur client name if needed).



The situation when you took it over or launched it.



What you did and why.



The real numbers. Spend, CPL, CPA, appointments, ROAS, whatever applies.

Location: Remote (Philippines preferred)

Start: Part time with clear pathway to full time

Compensation: 300–500 AUD/month part-time to start, with opportunitty to double revenue within probationary period of 3months.



About Us

We’re a fast growing uniforms and signage company with our own factory in Derrimut (Melbourne, Australia). We supply uniforms and branded workwear, as well as signage, to schools, local businesses and trade clients. We’re in the early stages of a big growth push, with strong landing pages, real customer testimonials, and a clear vision to dominate the local market.



We’re looking for our go to Performance Marketer, someone who wants to grow with us from the early days and become a key part of our team as we expand into more locations and services.



Why this role is exciting

Founding team style role: You won’t be “just another freelancer”, you’ll be the person building and running our first serious Google & Meta ad engine.



Fast growth upside: If we hit our targets, this role will move from part-time to full-time, with potential to earn up to 2x your starting rate within 3-6 months based on performance.



Future Australia pathway: For the right long-term, high performing person, we are open to exploring a business visa in the future so you can work with us on site as we expand.



Big impact, visible results: You’ll be working directly with the owners; your ideas and campaigns will be implemented fast, and you’ll see the direct connection between your work and real sales.



Role Overview

We’re hiring a Growth Performance Marketer (Google & Meta Ads) to own our paid acquisition for uniforms and signage. You’ll start part time, designing and running lean campaigns that generate consistent, high quality enquiries from local businesses around our factory.



As results come in and we scale, your hours and responsibilities will grow – with a clear path to leading our full digital acquisition function.



Responsibilities

Strategy & planning

Learn our offers (uniforms, workwear, signage), target customer types (warehouses, trades, small businesses, etc.), and local market around Melbourne.



Design a simple but effective paid media strategy that fits our small initial budget and can scale as results improve.



Work directly with the founders to align campaigns with our sales efforts (cold calls, in person visits,
 follow ups).



Google Ads (core channel)

Set up and manage highly targeted local Search campaigns for uniforms and signage.



Build and refine keyword groups focused on buyer intent searches (e.g. “work uniforms supplier”, “hi vis uniforms Melbourne”, “factory signage Derrimut”).



Write and test ad copy that highlights our strengths: fast turnaround, custom branding, local factory, strong testimonials.



Implement robust conversion tracking (forms, calls where possible) and optimise for cost per lead and lead quality.



Meta Ads (supporting channel)

Create and manage 
 campaigns on
/Instagram to re?engage website visitors.



When budget allows, test simple top of funnel campaigns to build awareness with local business audiences.



Use our existing photos, social proof, and before/after examples to build trust quickly.



Optimisation & reporting

Continuously improve campaigns by:



Adding negative keywords and pausing poor?performing terms.



Testing ad variations, audiences, and bidding strategies within budget.



Suggesting landing page tweaks to improve conversion rate (we’ll implement changes together).



Provide clear weekly reports (short Loom/video or written summary) showing:



Spend, clicks, leads (by channel)



What you tested/changed and why



Next actions for the following week



Minimum Requirements

Top 3 core skills:



Hands on Google Ads experience – especially local service campaigns driving leads (not just e-commerce or brand awareness).



Proven Meta Ads experience – building simple but effective lead gen and retargeting campaigns.



Performance mindset – you think in terms of cost per lead, lead quality, and return on ad spend, not just impressions and clicks.



Plus:



Experience working with small/medium businesses, ideally in trades, uniforms, printing, signage, or similar service industries.



Comfortable working with limited budgets and finding ways to maximise every dollar.



Strong written English and clear communication.



Self managed: able to propose ideas, take initiative, and report concisely without needing daily supervision.



Hours, Compensation & Growth Path

Starting structure (first 3–6 months)



Hours: 10–15 hours per week.



Compensation: 300–500 AUD per month (depending on experience and agreed scope).



Focus: setting up and stabilising Google Ads + Meta Ads, hitting initial lead targets and proving a profitable system.



Growth path (after proving results)



If we consistently hit agreed KPIs (for example: target cost per lead, number of leads per week, and conversion quality), we are open to:



Increasing hours to full time.



Increasing pay up to 2x your starting rate over time, in line with revenue growth driven by your campaigns.



Expanding your responsibilities into:



Wider digital strategy 
 follow up, basic funnel building).



Coordinating with additional tea
mbers (e.g. content, design, admin).



Potential business visa sponsorship discussions down the track to join us in Australia as part of our core team.



We will be transparent about targets and timelines so you can see exactly what performance levels unlock the next step.



How to Apply

2–3 brief examples of Google and/or Meta campaigns you’ve run for local or service businesses:



Industry



Rough monthly ad spend



What you did and the results (leads, cost per lead, improvements).



Your proposed monthly fee within the 300–500 AUD starting range and how many hours/week that covers.

title: Outbound Dialer / Client Qualification Specialist - Work From Home
description:
Outbound Dialer / Client Qualification Specialist - Work From Home



Important: Please Read This Full Position Brief Before Applying



We will only consider applicants who read and follow the full instructions in this job description.



If you do not follow the application requirements exactly, your application will not be considered and may be marked as spam.



About the Role

We are hiring a work-from-home Outbound Dialer / Client Qualification Specialist.



This is not cold calling. You will be contacting warm leads who have responded to our advertising, usually during the same day or the previous day. These leads have already shown interest and understand that they have made an inquiry.



Your main role is to call as many leads as possible throughout the day, speak with potential clients, and qualify whether they may be eligible for a Total and Permanent Disability insurance claim to be developed by our legal team.



Calls are made through a dial pad inside our CRM. Each tea
mber is provided with their own access so calls can be tracked and monitored.



The Person We Are Looking For

We need someone who is a self-starter, confident on the phone, organised, and able to approach the role with enthusiasm and tenacity.



Success in this role is measured by:



Calls made

Leads qualified

Client sign-ups

Accurate follow-up work

Strong organisation and communication

Exceptional, fluent spoken English is essential. If you are not able to confidently and fluently converse in English, please do not apply.



Additional Admin Responsibilities

Once a client is qualified, there are administrative steps that must be completed. This includes gathering information from the client, sending initial inquiries to insurers and superannuation funds, and staying on top of follow-up tasks.



You will work closely with our Philippines-based admin team and our Sydney-based legal team. You will help make sure matters continue moving through the process, including following up on medical certificates, employment records, insurer information, superannuation fund responses, and other required documents.



There may be times when all leads have been contacted before the end of the day. When that happens, you will be expected to move into admin-related work. Flexibility is very important in this role.



Hours and Working Arrangement

This is a contracted work-from-home role.



Hours are Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm Sydney time.



As a contractor, you are responsible for your own equipment, internet connection, local obligations, and working setup in the Philippines.



We are a stable and mature company with strong long-term prospects for remote work. The role includes two weeks of vacation time over Christmas, pro-rated depending on your start date, as well as agreed holiday time.



Tools and Training Provided

We will provide access to:



CRM

Legal CRM

DocuSign

Dialpad

Training to get you up to speed

Strict Application Requirements

To apply, you must
 your application to:







Your
 subject line must be:



Application - Outbound Dialer - [Your Full Name]



Your application must include:



An up-to-date CV

A short covering letter

An original 60-second voice recording reading the script below

The recording must be made specifically for this job application. Do not send an old recording, a generic voice sample, or an AI-generated recording.



Script for Voice Recording

“Hi, my name is [your name], and I’m calling in relation to your recent inquiry about a possible Total and Permanent Disability insurance claim.



I just need to ask you a few quick questions to understand your situation and see whether this may be something our team can assist with.



The call should only take a few minutes. I’ll go through some basic details with you, and if it looks like you may qualify, our team can explain the next steps and what information may be needed.



Is now still a good time to speak?”



Final Note

Applications that do not follow the instructions above will not be considered and may be marked as spam.

title: Quality Assurance Surveyor / Construction Estimator with Residential and Commercial projects Experience in Australia
description:
This post is a WFH setup role and needs a strong understanding of residential and/or light commercial construction methods in Australia.



The Quality Assurance Surveyor / Construction Estimator is responsible for ensuring construction projects meet required quality standards while also preparing accurate and competitive cost estimates for residential and light commercial projects across Australia. This remote role supports both project quality assurance and pre-construction tendering processes by reviewing drawings, specifications, materials, workmanship, and cost requirements in line with Australian Standards and the National Construction Code (NCC).



Key Responsibilities



- Conduct inspections, surveys, and quality checks to ensure compliance with project specifications, Australian Standards, and NCC requirements.

- Review architectural, structural, and engineering drawings, specifications, and contract documentation.

- Monitor construction activities, materials, and workmanship to verify adherence to approved plans and quality standards.

- Perform detailed quantity take-offs and prepare accurate cost estimates for labour, materials, plant, and subcontractor packages.

- Prepare Bills of Quantities (BOQs), tender submissions, and estimating reports.

- Obtain, review, and evaluate supplier and subcontractor quotations.

- Identify defects, non-conformities, scope gaps, risks, and inconsistencies in construction and tender documentation.

- Recommend corrective actions and apply value engineering principles to improve cost efficiency without compromising compliance or quality.

- Prepare and maintain quality assurance reports, inspection records, cost databases, and estimating documentation.

Coordinate with engineers, contractors, project managers, suppliers, and subcontractors to resolve quality and costing issues.

- Ensure compliance with safety regulations, local building codes, industry standards, and quality management systems.

- Participate in quality audits, risk assessments, and testing/commissioning verification.

- Support project handovers and assist with variation pricing and post-contract cost adjustments when required.



Required Qualifications



- Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, or a related field.

- Minimum of 5 years of experience in construction estimating, quality assurance, quality control, or site inspection.

- Proven experience within the Australian construction industry is highly preferred.

- Strong understanding of residential and/or light commercial construction methods in Australia.

- Knowledge of Australian Standards, NCC requirements, construction quality procedures, and estimating practices.

- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, engineering plans, specifications, and contracts.

- Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.





Technical Skills / Tools



- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel for cost modelling and reporting.

- Experience with Buildsoft, Jobpack, Estate Master, and Xero is advantageous.

- Familiarity with ClickUp or similar project/task management software.

- Knowledge of construction materials testing, surveying equipment, and inspection tools.

- Experience maintaining Australian construction cost databases and rate libraries.



Key Attributes



- Strong understanding of the Australian construction environment.

- Highly organised with strong time management and multitasking skills.

- Commercially focused with a practical and proactive approach.

- Able to work independently and manage deadlines effectively in a remote environment.

- Strong stakeholder coordination and communication skills.

- Proactive in identifying risks, improving estimating accuracy, and maintaining quality standards.





Work Environment



- Fully remote role supporting Australian residential and light commercial construction projects.
