title: Orthodontic VA
description:
Virtual Assistant — Orthodontic Insurance & Digital Treatment Coordinator

Next Level Orthodontics | Gainesville, FL (Remote)

Full-Time or Part-Time | Philippines-Based Candidates Welcome



About Us

Next Level Orthodontics (NLO) is a private orthodontic specialty practice in Gainesville, Florida. We are an out-of-network (OON) provider offering braces, clear aligners, and Phase I/II treatment for children and adults. We are a small, close-knit team that takes pride in delivering high-quality care and a smooth patient experience from the first phone call to the final retainer appointment.

We use Edge Cloud as our practice management system, Weave for patient communication, and Asana for internal task and case management.



The Role

We are looking for a sharp, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant with a dental or healthcare background to own two critical areas of our practice:



Insurance Verification & Benefits Coordination — verifying OON orthodontic benefits for new and existing patients before their appointments

In-House Aligner Case Setup (Titan) — acting as a remote digital technician, setting up in-house aligner cases in Titan under the direct supervision and training of the doctor



This is not a general admin role. You will be working inside our practice management system daily, communicating with insurance companies on behalf of patients, and coordinating directly with our clinical and front-office team. Accuracy, ownership, and attention to detail are non-negotiable.



Key Responsibilities

Insurance Verification & Benefits (Primary)



Verify orthodontic benefits for scheduled patients 3–5 business days ahead of their appointment

Confirm the following for every patient: plan type, orthodontic lifetime maximum, amount used, OON reimbursement percentage, deductible, waiting periods, age limits, and coordination of benefits (COB) if dual coverage exists

Call insurance companies directly when portal data is incomplete or unclear

Document all verified benefit details accurately inside Edge Cloud patient records

Flag discrepancies, OON limitations, or unusual plan restrictions and communicate them to the Financial Coordinator before the patient's appointment

Maintain a verification tracker and ensure nothing falls through the cracks



In-House Aligner Case Setup — Titan (Secondary)



Set up clear aligner cases in Titan for our in-house aligner patients under the direction of Dr. Akhavan

This is a digital technician role — you will be trained directly by the doctor on our specific setup protocols and preferences

Follow case-specific clinical instructions provided by Dr. Akhavan for each patient

Update Asana with case stage and completion status

Flag any cases that need clinical review or revision before finalization

Maintain organized digital records for each Titan case



General Administrative Support



Monitor and respond to internal Weave messages and task assignments during scheduled hours

Support scheduling coordinators with insurance-related patient callbacks when needed

Assist with claims documentation as directed by the Financial Coordinator





Required Qualifications



Minimum 2 years of dental or orthodontic administrative experience (insurance verification, billing, or front-office)

Solid understanding of dental/orthodontic insurance terminology: OON benefits, ortho lifetime max, COB, waiting periods, frequency limits, EOB

Experience calling insurance companies and navigating payer portals (Delta Dental, Cigna, Aetna, United Healthcare, MetLife, BlueCross, Humana)

HIPAA certified (must provide certificate prior to start date)

Strong written and spoken English

Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated, distraction-free workspace

Comfortable working U.S. Eastern Time business hours (Gainesville, FL)





Preferred Qualifications



Prior experience with Edge Cloud, Dentrix, Eaglesoft, or similar dental PMS

Experience with Asana or similar project management tools

Familiarity with Titan or other in-house aligner design software a plus (full training provided)

Experience supporting an out-of-network dental or orthodontic practice

Background in orthodontic specialty (vs. general dentistry) strongly preferred





What We Offer



Competitive hourly rate (based on experience)

Consistent, predictable hours — no surprises

A small, supportive team that communicates clearly and respects your time

Long-term opportunity with room to grow into a broader role as our practice expands

Full training on our specific systems, workflows, and protocols provided





HIPAA & Security Requirements

Because you will access patient health information (PHI), the following are mandatory before your start date:



Signed Business Associate Agreement (BAA) with NLO

Completed HIPAA training with certificate on file

Use of a VPN during all work sessions

Access to our systems via secure remote desktop only (we will provide setup instructions)

No downloading or storing PHI on personal devices — ever





How to Apply

Please send the following:



Your resume or CV with relevant dental/healthcare experience highlighted

A brief paragraph (3–5 sentences) describing your experience with dental insurance verification — specifically OON benefits

Your available hours and time zone

Your HIPAA certification (or confirmation you are willing to complete training before start)

Your hourly rate expectation



Applications without dental or healthcare experience will not be considered.

title: Full-Time AI Automation & Business Process Specialist
description:
Full-Time AI Automation & Operations Specialist for Established Australian Business Group



Salary will be based on experience, skill level, and long-term fit. Please include your expected monthly salary in PHP when applying.



We are an established and reputable Australian business group looking to hire a full-time AI Automation and Business Process Specialist based in the Philippines.



Our family business operates across multiple industries, including property development, farming, fresh produce supply, restaurant and hospitality supply, accounting, research, operations, and marketing. We are continuing to grow and are opening more businesses in the future, so we are looking for a dedicated person who wants to build a long-term career with us.



We already have many valued tea
mbers from the Philippines working across our businesses. Some of our Filipino staff have been with us for more than 10 years, and we are proud to offer stable, secure, and long-term opportunities to the right people. We currently have more than 60 employees across our group and are looking for someone who will become an important part of our future growth.



This role is ideal for someone who understands how to use modern AI tools, automation platforms, software systems, spreadsheets, databases, and digital workflows to improve business operations. You will work across several of our businesses and help us create better systems, reduce manual work, improve reporting, organise information, and automate repetitive processes.



The successful candidate will work closely with management to understand how our businesses operate and identify opportunities to improve systems and processes. You will help automate tasks across accounting, property, research, marketing, administration, reporting, and general business operations.



This is not a short-term project role. We are looking for someone loyal, reliable, intelligent, and committed to growing with our company for many years.



Your responsibilities will include learning how our businesses operate and helping us build practical systems that save time, reduce errors, and improve productivity.



You will help create and maintain automation workflows, improve spreadsheets, organise data, document processes, research software tools, and help management implement better ways of working.



You will also assist with business research, reporting, property-related administration, accounting process support, marketing operations, and general system improvements.



Examples of the work include:



- Building and improving automations using AI tools, workflow platforms, spreadsheets, integrations, and business software.

- Assisting with process improvements for invoicing, reporting, reconciliations, document handling, and data organisation.

- Helping organise property information, research opportunities, manage documents, and create systems for tracking projects.

- Conducting online research, gathering information, comparing options, preparing summaries, and organising findings clearly.

- Helping automate marketing workflows, organise leads, improve reporting, assist with content systems, and support campaign processes.

- Reviewing current workflows, identifying inefficiencies, and recommending better tools, templates, processes, and automations.

- Creating dashboards, spreadsheets, trackers, reports, and summaries that help management make better decisions.



The ideal candidate will have strong technical confidence, excellent written English, and a genuine interest in AI, automation, systems, and business improvement.



We are looking for someone with skills or experience in:



- AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms.

- Automation platforms such as n8n , Zapier, Make, Airtable, Notion, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, CRMs, or similar systems.

- Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, data cleaning, reports, trackers, and dashboards.

- Business process improvement and workflow organisation.

- Online research and clear written summaries.

- Documenting processes and creating simple systems for teams to follow.

- Clear written English and professional communication.

- Managing multiple tasks across different business areas.



You do not need to know every tool already, but you must be a fast learner who can research, test, and implement new solutions.



We are looking for someone who is honest, reliable, proactive, and committed. The right person will take ownership of their work, follow instructions carefully, and also think independently when solving problems.



Because this role will support many areas of our business, you must be organised, patient, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities.

title: Sales Manager
description:
SALES MANAGER – GLOBAL B2B / OEM MANUFACTURING



We are looking for a dynamic and results-driven Sales Manager to lead global business development initiatives for our OEM and private label manufacturing business. This role is ideal for a highly motivated sales professional with strong B2B sales experience, preferably with exposure to manufacturing, sourcing, retail, consumer goods, or related industries.



The Sales Manager will be responsible for developing and managing relationships with international clients, including customers in the US market, while driving growth across OEM manufacturing, private label partnerships, corporate accounts, and retail opportunities.



This role offers international exposure, travel opportunities, and potential relocation to our Vietnam office depending on business needs.



Position Overview



The Sales Manager will play a key role in expanding the company’s global customer base and strengthening long-term client partnerships. The ideal candidate is commercially driven, proactive, and capable of managing complex B2B sales cycles from lead generation to account management.



While footwear industry experience is an advantage, we are also open to candidates from other industries with strong B2B sales backgrounds and experience handling international clients.



Key Responsibilities

1. Develop and execute strategic sales and business development plans to drive company growth globally.

2. Identify and pursue new business opportunities for OEM manufacturing, private label production, corporate partnerships, and retail accounts.

3. Build and maintain strong relationships with international clients, distributors, retailers, and brand partners, particularly in the US and global markets.

4. Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting, presentation, negotiation, and closing to account management.

5. Understand client requirements and coordinate closely with internal teams including development, production, sourcing, and logistics to ensure successful project execution.

6. Conduct market research and monitor industry trends, competitor activities, and emerging opportunities.

7. Prepare sales reports, forecasts, and market insights for management review.

8. Represent the company in client meetings, business trips, trade shows, and industry events locally and internationally.

9. Support the company’s expansion initiatives and contribute to strengthening its global market presence.



Qualifications:

1. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, International Business, or related field.

2. Proven experience in B2B sales, business development, or account management.

3. Experience handling international or global accounts is highly preferred.

4. Background in manufacturing, OEM/private label, sourcing, consumer goods, apparel, footwear, retail, or related industries is an advantage.

5. Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

6. Ability to manage multiple projects and work in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.

7. Strong commercial mindset with the ability to identify and develop new business opportunities.

8. Willingness to travel internationally as required.

9. Open to relocation or extended assignment in Vietnam when needed.

10. Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

title: Organic Content Lead / Director
description:
Ancient Remedies is a fast-moving natural health and wellness company on a mission to help people help themselves through holistic medicine. We make beautiful, practical books about herbal remedies, food as medicine, and natural health — and we sell thousands of books every day through paid channels.



Now we need to build the organic side of the brand.



Our organic presence is underbuilt. We have real products, real customers, and a mission people care about, but our social content does not yet reflect the trust, warmth, usefulness, and authority of the brand we are building. We do not want engagement bait. We do not want generic “Big Pharma doesn’t want you to know this” content. We want social content that makes people feel: this brand understands me, helps me, and can be trusted.



This role exists to own that shift.



You will lead the day-to-day organic social strategy across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts,
, and future channels. You will define what we post, why we post it, how it should feel, and how we improve. You’ll turn Ancient Remedies into a brand people are proud to follow, save, share, and buy from.



This is a high-ownership role. You will not be handed a perfect system. You will build the system. You’ll create content pillars, test formats, direct editors or creators, analyze performance, and raise the standard of everything we publish. The right person will have a rare mix of social taste, customer empathy, brand judgment, and speed.



What You’ll Own

• Define and execute the organic social strategy for Ancient Remedies.

• Build content that drives reach while increasing trust, authority, and brand warmth.

• Create repeatable content series around natural health, herbal remedies, food as medicine, seasonal wellness, and our books.

• Write hooks, scripts, captions, content briefs, and creative direction for short-form videos.

• Manage the content calendar and posting rhythm across key platforms.

• Work with editors, creators, or internal tea
mbers to produce content quickly.

• Identify what is working, what is not, and what we should test next.

• Improve the quality of our public-facing brand presence.

• Protect the brand from low-trust, legally risky, or off-mission content.

• Report clearly on performance, insights, and next steps.



Who We’re Looking For



We are looking for someone who understands social media at a deep, native level — but also understands that not all attention is good attention.



You should have strong taste. You can look at a post and explain why it works, why it feels cheap, why it builds trust, or why it damages the brand. You know the difference between content that gets views and content that creates real brand equity.



You should be genuinely interested in natural health, wellness, herbal remedies, food as medicine, or helping people take better care of themselves at home. You do not need to be a medical expert, but you need to care about the category and respect the customer.



You should be comfortable moving fast, testing often, and owning outcomes. This is not a role for someone who waits to be told exactly what to do. We want someone who brings ideas, notices problems, raises the bar, and takes responsibility.



You may be a great fit if you have:

• Experience growing or managing organic social accounts for a brand, creator, publisher, wellness company, education company, or consumer product.

• Strong instincts for short-form video, hooks, retention, storytelling, and platform-native content.

• A portfolio that shows real taste — not just trends, templates, or generic edits.

• The ability to direct editors, creators, or UGC talent.

• Comfort being scrappy: filming, briefing, scripting, posting, analyzing, and iterating.

• High standards for brand trust, accuracy, and customer perception.

• Clear communication and strong ownership.



This role is for someone who wants to build something meaningful, not just “run social.”

title: AI Fashion Image Creator, E-commerce Product Photography (Gemini/Nano Banana)
description:
We're a growing e-commerce fashion brand. We turn basic supplier photos (AliExpress-style) into clean, premium-looking product images using AI image generation. We need someone who can do this consistently and who can judge their own work, not just press generate and send whatever comes out.



This is the most important sentence in this post: the skill we're hiring for is not "can you use the tool." It's "can you look at a generated image and know whether it looks premium or cheap, whether the model is consistent, whether the fabric pattern broke, whether a white dress disappears into a white background." If you can't see those things, this role is not for you.



Type: Part-time to start, ongoing for the right person



Salary: $4 an hour with possibility for increases over time.



What you'll do:

- Take supplier product photos plus a prompt template we provide

- Generate clean e-commerce image sets (hero, full body, back, detail) on a consistent studio background

- Keep the same model identity across every angle of a product

- Catch and fix problems: pattern misalignment, wrong colors, stiff poses, garments merging into the background

- Produce color variants of the same garment



You're a fit if:

- You have real experience with AI image generation (Midjourney, Gemini/Nano Banana, Seedream, Flux, etc.)

- You've done fashion or e-commerce product imagery before, show us

- You have an eye for what looks expensive vs. what looks like obvious AI junk

- You're meticulous and you re-do work that isn't right instead of sending it



You're NOT a fit if:

- Your plan is to paste our prompt, generate once, and send the first result

- You've never worked with fashion/clothing imagery

- You can't tell us why one generated image is better than another



Tools and growth: Once hired, you'll get access to a Claude account connected to Higgsfield so you can work efficiently and at volume. In the beginning the work will be mainly image generation. Over time the role can expand into handling the full product listing task.



To apply (applications that skip this are ignored):

- Link 3 to 5 examples of AI fashion/product images you've made

- One sentence: what's the most common mistake you see in AI-generated clothing images, and how do you fix it?



Shortlisted applicants will get a short unpaid test assignment so we can see your skill and approach before hiring.
